home.practice_forging_blurb: Strike a hot plate spot by spot. Each spot's mark says where the press lands next: keep it moving until the whole plate is set.
forging.title: Forging
forging.how_to: Tap a lit spot to strike it. Every spot takes three strikes before it is set, and shows a mark that says where the next strike may land: a step of one to four in any straight line, a rail to the edge along its row or column, a slant to the edge along a diagonal, a star to either, a hook two along and one across. Every strike scores, the same mark twice in a row builds a chain, and the round ends when the press has nowhere left to land, so keep a way out.
forging.how_to_keyboard: Arrows or WASD move the cursor. Space or enter strikes the spot under it.
forging.sets_note: Four strikes in a row holding each step once (one, two, three, four) are a count. Four holding rail, slant, star and hook once each are a span. A set begun right after a set of the other kind links into a weave, and each link pays more.
forging.spark_note: When the whole plate has been struck once, the last spot you struck shows a spark, and again when it has all been struck twice. A spark lands anywhere, and stands in for any mark in a chain or a set.
forging.hint_note: Practice rounds ring a strike worth making when you pause.
forging.stage.steps_intro: Steps of one, two and three. Keep the press moving: when it has nowhere to go, the round is over.
forging.stage.jumps_intro: Rails, slants and hooks join the steps. Rails and slants only land on the plate's edge.
forging.stage.sets_intro: Strike each step once for a count, each jump once for a span, and switch between them for a weave.
forging.stage.full_intro: Sparks land anywhere and stand in for any mark. Save one for when the press is cornered.
forging.legend_heat: A spot's size is its heat: three strikes left, two, one. A set spot is a dot.
forging.legend_lit: Lit spots are where the press can land next.
forging.legend_lead: The framed mark over the plate is the one you last struck. The spot it was on has a new mark now; the framed one says where the press lands next.
forging.mark.one: Step one: one spot away in a straight line.
forging.mark.two: Step two: two spots away in a straight line.
forging.mark.three: Step three: three spots away in a straight line.
forging.mark.four: Step four: four spots away in a straight line.
forging.mark.rail: Rail: the edge spot along its row or column.
forging.mark.slant: Slant: the edge spot along a diagonal.
forging.mark.star: Star: the edge spot along any line.
forging.mark.hook: Hook: two along and one across.
forging.mark.spark: Spark: any live spot. Stands in for any mark.
studio.preset.forging_steps_only: Steps only: no jumps, no sets
studio.preset.forging_small_plate: A small plate: five by five
studio.preset.forging_flat_weave: Flat weave: linked sets pay no more
